references.text: The Levites were to carry the ark using poles, which shows the prescribed way of transporting the ark of the covenant.
The Kohathites, a Levitical clan, were responsible for carrying the holy objects, including the ark.
The Lord's ark of the covenant went ahead of the people to find a resting place for them, just as the ark led the people across the Jordan.
Moses describes how the Levitical priests carried the Lord's ark of the covenant.
The Levites who carried the Lord's ark of the covenant were instructed to place the book of the law beside the ark.
Joshua gave orders to the priests to take up the ark of the covenant and go ahead of the people.
The priests who carried the ark stood in the middle of the Jordan while the people crossed over, and then went ahead of the people.
The priests were again ordered to carry the ark of the covenant, this time around Jericho.
At Sinai, the people were commanded to keep their distance from the mountain, parallel to the command to keep their distance from the ark.
